passages.note: Opposes ICE enforcement against a documented asylum family but states no rule on who should be removed.
A No vote on a state border and illegal-entry referral shows the side only; no lever at this level.

passages.provision_quote: It is unlawful for a person who is an alien to enter or attempt to enter this state directly from a foreign nation at any location other than a lawful port of entry.
passages.note: State criminal-entry law is direction-only per the annex; it sets no removal rule for all undocumented immigrants.
Quoted criticism of ICE profiling in one arrest; no stated position on who should be deported.

rows.reasoning: Her own words oppose ICE enforcement that takes documented asylum seekers, and she voted No on HCR2060, but nothing states a rule such as "Stop deportations entirely and protect undocumented immigrants from removal" or limits removal to serious violent convictions. The passages show the side only, not a rung.
